_readme: Copy to config/messengers.json (git-ignored) or fill it in on the Setup page → Text her. A bot answers only the user ids listed under allowed_users; everyone else is told their id so you can add it. Discord: Developer Portal → New Application → Bot → Reset Token; invite it with the `bot` scope (no permissions are needed for DMs; add Send Messages to use it in a server, where it answers when @mentioned). Telegram: @BotFather → /newbot → the token; send the bot /id to learn your id.
